name: Commodities — Kalshi Research Exchange
relevance: Sister project: automated forward-test desk for Kalshi event contracts. PRICINGEXPERT's competition model (per-year seasons, username personas, max-return ranking) is an independent implementation.

name: MLBComp — Auditable MLB Research & Paper Competition
relevance: Reference for the research->discover->verify->model->backtest->forward-test loop and for the 'verified timestamped quote before anything is staked' gate. Its withdrawn-fabricated-data episode (IRR-64/IRR-72 in the MasterSite) is the cautionary pattern this project's hash-bound evidence design avoids.

name: DrugAnalysis — FDA Decisions & Biotech Reactions
relevance: Reference for event-timing research methodology: official decision timestamps (openFDA) joined to verified price reactions, with every row carrying payload file + SHA. The same pattern applies to Kalshi: official settlement/release timestamps vs captured market quotes.
